title: Large Label outline creates holes inside enclosed glyphs
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.7.1.stable, v4.0.4.stable.official - Not tested in other versions. ### System information Godot v4.7.1.stable (a13da4feb) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.31035.1003) - AMD Ryzen 5 7500F 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.73 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description When using a large outline size in LabelSettings, enclosed glyphs such as `0`, `%`, `8`, `B`, etc. develop visible holes inside the outline. The issue is reproducible in a brand new project and occurs with every font I tested (TTF and OTF). The holes become more noticeable with larger outline sizes. When zooming or scaling the text, the holes change shape and even appear to move instead of remaining in a fixed position. Interestingly, using multiple small Stacked Outlines to achieve the same total thickness does not produce the issue, while using a single large outline does. Expected behavior: A single thick outline should produce the same visual result as several smaller stacked outlines with the same total thickness. Actual behavior: Large outlines leave holes inside enclosed glyphs. --- v Tested in 4.7.1 with using multiple Stacked Outlines (The outline should remain continuous without holes, regardless of outline thickness.) v Tested in 4.7.1 v Tested in 4.0.4 ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a new project. 2. Create a Label. 3. Assign a LabelSettings resource. 4. Set Outline Size to 16. 5. Enter text such as `100%` or `0000`. 6. Observe holes appearing inside enclosed glyphs. Optional comparison: - Replace the single 16 px outline with several small Stacked Outlines whose total thickness is also 16 px. - The holes no longer appear. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [test_for_outline.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30795204/test_for_outline.zip)
